query:
SELECT c.id, c.claim_number, c.source_document_id, c.damage_photos, c.external_assessment_url,
       c.document_processing_status, c.ai_assessment_started_at, c.updated_at,
       d.id as doc_id, d.original_filename, d.s3_url
FROM claims c
LEFT JOIN ingestion_documents d ON d.id = c.source_document_id
WHERE c.id = 5850001;
